title: Demo arm does not route through notification_target_path — vacancy-typed demo clicks still no-op (still present since round 1)
detail: Round-2 hard blocker: "BOTH the real arm (client.gleam) and demo arm (demo_update.gleam) must route through it". Only client.gleam:4399 calls notification_target_path; the demo arm inlines a partial duplicate matching only "application", so vacancy demo clicks never navigate, violating the spec AC "demo fixtures navigate too".
recommended_fix: Move notification_target_path/3 (and resolve_application_vacancy) into a neutral module importable by both arms (demo_update cannot import client), and call it from the demo click arm so vacancy and application both navigate.

title: ApiReturnedLeaderboard applies Success without vacancy-id guard — late response after vacancy switch re-opens the fabricated-id window
evidence:
ApiReturnedLeaderboard(result) ->
      case result {
        Ok(response) -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Success(response.entries),
            leaderboard_total: response.total,
detail: The message carries no vacancy_id, so the response applies entries under whatever leaderboard_vacancy_id the latest request set. Navigate A -> B before A's response lands: Success(A entries) tagged Some(B); an A-application click then resolves Some(B) — the B1 fabrication. The refresh variant (line 1337) guards on vacancy_detail_request_id; this one doesn't.
recommended_fix: Add vacancy_id to ApiReturnedLeaderboard (set at dispatch in AppRequestedLeaderboard) and apply only when it equals model.leaderboard_vacancy_id / vacancy_detail_request_id, mirroring ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh.

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding still untested (still present since round 1)
detail: R1 warning: pb-28 is pinned only for application_detail. The r2 diff adds no vacancy_detail padding test — grep of client/test shows pb-28 only at client_test.gleam:5128/5139/5149, all inside application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test. A revert of the vacancy_detail.gleam:104 fix goes uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids is non-empty and absent when empty, mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test.

title: Filter pill shrink-0 change (fix 3) still has no test (still present since round 1)
detail: R1 warning: the only shrink-0 pins in client/test are the stepper tests (client_test.gleam:5115-5119); no leaderboard_view test asserts the filter pills carry shrink-0, and the r2 diff adds none. The chip-truncation root-cause fix is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view render test asserting the filter pill elements carry shrink-0 (and whitespace-nowrap).

title: Rejected/auto-closed stepper rails still lack md:justify-end that the pipeline rail gained (still present since round 1)
evidence: "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end"
detail: Only the pipeline rail (line 210) right-aligns on desktop; view_rejected (321) and view_auto_closed (381) end at md:overflow-visible with no justification, an unexplained divergence from the previously identical classes.
recommended_fix: Add md:justify-end to the view_rejected and view_auto_closed containers, or comment the intentional difference.

title: demo_flow_test still binds notifications then discards with let _ (still present since round 1)
evidence:
let #(notifications, unread) = demo_store.notifications_unread(store)
  unread |> should.equal(1)
  after.show_notification_dropdown |> should.be_false
  let _ = notifications
detail: The test never asserts the clicked row n-1 is is_read == True; the stated "marks the row read" contract is pinned only via the unread count dropping to 1.
recommended_fix: Assert the notifications list contains n-1 with is_read == True, or destructure as #(_, unread).
